nodes.label: @inquirer/prompts (replaced)
nodes.rationale: Replaced by @clack/prompts in 0.3.0.

nodes.label: cfm (Contentful entry migration CLI)
nodes.rationale: Migrates Contentful entries between environments (e.g. develop -> qa) together with their children; everything stays in draft. Formerly named ctf-migrate. Runs the single-file build in dist/.

nodes.label: cfm-dev (source-code command)
nodes.rationale: Runs src/ TypeScript directly without compiling so edits apply instantly; must be installed as a link because Node does not execute .ts inside node_modules; starts slower than cfm.

nodes.label: @clack/prompts (chosen terminal UI)
nodes.rationale: Covers all prompts and progress indicators in one style with 4 small dependencies and no install scripts.

nodes.label: commander (rejected)
nodes.rationale: Node parseArgs already handles commands/flags with Spanish messages and tests; commander adds a dependency and English messages.

nodes.label: consola (rejected)
nodes.rationale: Its logs duplicate clack's and its prompts are built on clack: two styles for the same thing.

nodes.label: esbuild
nodes.rationale: Bundler used only by the build script; dev dependency added in 0.12.0.

nodes.label: Ink (rejected)
nodes.rationale: React for terminal aimed at full screens; 20+ deps plus React and JSX which Node cannot run uncompiled (would break cfm-dev); the flow is a step-by-step wizard.

nodes.label: listr2 (rejected)
nodes.rationale: Meant for parallel task trees; writes are intentionally sequential and clack's progress bar covers it without taking over the screen.

nodes.label: 0.5.0 — command renamed to cfm
nodes.rationale: Command name taken from package.json in all messages so a future rename happens in one place; backups stay in ~/.ctf-migrate/backups/ to keep existing ones.

nodes.label: pnpm allowBuilds / onlyBuiltDependencies for esbuild
nodes.rationale: pnpm-only config (npm and bun ignore it) letting esbuild run its install script; without it pnpm 11+ fails. allowBuilds for pnpm 11+, onlyBuiltDependencies for pnpm 10.

nodes.label: Erasable-syntax-only TypeScript rules
nodes.rationale: Node strips types on the fly, so imports use .ts extension, no enum/namespace/parameter properties (use `as const` objects like ACTION), `import type` for types; enforced by tsc erasableSyntaxOnly.

nodes.label: Minimal pinned dependencies policy
nodes.rationale: Only 3 runtime deps (contentful-management, @clack/prompts, picocolors) and dev deps (typescript, @types/node, @biomejs/biome), all exact versions, claimed to have no install scripts; package is private to avoid accidental npm publish.

nodes.label: Package-manager agnostic, no lockfiles
nodes.rationale: Project does not force npm, pnpm or bun and commits no lockfiles: each person installs with their own manager; direct deps are pinned to exact versions instead. Commands must be installed with only one manager to avoid PATH confusion.

nodes.label: Single-file esbuild build (dist/cli.js)
nodes.rationale: Bundles code and dependencies (contentful-management, axios...) into one file so cfm opens ~20 files at startup instead of ~440; cold-disk first runs were slow because every file counts. dist/ is not committed.

nodes.label: Stale build warning
nodes.rationale: cfm warns before starting if src/ is newer than the build (and still runs the old build); if never built it tells you to run build or use cfm-dev.

nodes.label: Contentful session / CMA token
nodes.rationale: Token read from CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN or ~/.contentfulrc.json (from `contentful login`); 401 means the session expired.

nodes.label: Test isolation (no network, temporary HOME)
nodes.rationale: test/setup.ts loads before each test file: all network fails and HOME is a temp folder, so no test can reach Contentful or see the real session, token or backups.

nodes.label: Token sent only to Contentful API hosts
nodes.norm_label: token sent only to contentful api hosts
nodes.rationale: Token only goes to api.contentful.com or api.eu.contentful.com; tool stops if the session file points elsewhere; errors never print the request.

nodes.label: How to extend cfm
nodes.rationale: New command: add to COMMANDS/FLAGS in cli-args.ts, write function using context.ts, register in registry.ts; menu and help update automatically. New write type: method in write.ts plus phase in execute.ts.

nodes.label: Version bump policy (minor = feature/behavior, patch = fix)
nodes.norm_label: version bump policy (minor = feature/behavior, patch = fix)
nodes.rationale: Every change bumps the version: new feature or behavior change bumps minor, a fix bumps patch.

nodes.label: Back navigation (Esc / ← Volver)
nodes.rationale: Esc returns to the previous question up to the menu; Contentful reads stay in memory so going back repeats no calls; questions answered by flags are skipped; Ctrl+C exits.

nodes.label: Per-account backups (~/.ctf-migrate/backups/<cuenta>/)
nodes.rationale: Before updating an existing entry its previous state is saved, and if it cannot be saved it is not updated; one folder per Contentful account so backups and history of multiple accounts do not mix.

nodes.label: Decision flags (--update, --assets/--no-assets, --model)
nodes.rationale: Let every prompt be answered by flags; --model takes create:/info:/add:/rules:/editor: change ids; final confirmation is always asked.

nodes.label: --dry-run
nodes.rationale: Runs the full analysis and summary and stops; writes nothing to Contentful and creates no backup.

nodes.label: Editor appearance (help text, widget, settings)
nodes.rationale: Contentful stores it apart from the model, so it was being lost; copied automatically on create/add fields and offered per field otherwise. Empty help text, empty settings, omitted default widget and widget default settings saved on confirm count as equal. From app/extension widgets only help text is copied so the editor does not break if the app is missing in destination. Recorded in backup, not reverted by restore.

nodes.label: Entry selection methods
nodes.rationale: By ID/URL (pasted, also from Excel), text search, content type, recently changed (--mine), tag, file, or missing in destination; each option shows its API cost; searches are a single call up to 50 results.

nodes.label: Environment ordering (develop/qa first, production last)
nodes.rationale: Production (master or aliased env) shown last and marked; choosing it as origin asks for confirmation since the normal flow is test -> production.

nodes.label: Field rules (name, required, localized, validations, disabled, omitted, default)
nodes.norm_label: field rules (name, required, localized, validations, disabled, omitted, default)
nodes.rationale: Origin rules are carried over; the option warns when existing content may be affected (required -> unpublishable empties, un-localized -> lose other locales, omitted -> site stops receiving it). Previous state kept in backup; restore does not revert it.

nodes.label: history command
nodes.rationale: Lists past migrations of the logged-in account from local backups; 1 API call only to know which account you are.

nodes.label: migrate-assets command
nodes.rationale: Copies standalone images/files by ID/URL or name search; reuses those already in destination.

nodes.label: migrate command (migrate entries)
nodes.rationale: Migrates parent + children entries between environments in draft: choose space/envs, select entries, review tree, assets, model, summary, confirm.

nodes.label: migrate-model command
nodes.rationale: Creates content types and adds missing fields, rules, content-type data and editor appearance without content; never deletes fields or changes their ID or type.

nodes.label: Parent/child entry tree
nodes.rationale: The pasted entry (parent) and the entries it links to (children); existing children are reused untouched; rich-text hyperlinks are not children and are not migrated.

nodes.label: "Repetir" (repeat) command
nodes.rationale: Every command shows the same command with flags for all choices (space, envs, entries, decisions) so it can be redone without prompts.

nodes.label: restore command (undo migration)
nodes.rationale: Returns updated entries to their backed-up state; what was created is never deleted because the tool never deletes; restore itself creates a backup so it can be undone.

nodes.label: --verbose (API call logging)
nodes.rationale: Shows each API call (method, path, params) but never headers or token; disables background prefetch so lines do not mix with the menu.

nodes.label: Assets copied only from Contentful CDN (*.ctfassets.net)
nodes.norm_label: assets copied only from contentful cdn (*.ctfassets.net)

nodes.label: Background Contentful prefetch while menu shows
nodes.norm_label: background contentful prefetch while menu shows
nodes.rationale: Spaces (and environments when space is known) are fetched while the user looks at the menu so they are usually ready on selection.

nodes.label: Destination-preserving entry merge
nodes.rationale: Only fields existing in both models with the same type are updated; destination-only fields, locales and translations keep their values; tags from origin are added and none removed.

nodes.label: Existing-entry change detection
nodes.rationale: Builds the entry as it would end up in destination using the same write rules and compares with the current one, so locale/key order, locales missing in destination and fields with another type do not count as changes.

nodes.label: Guarantee: never publishes entries/assets, never deletes
nodes.norm_label: guarantee: never publishes entries/assets, never deletes
nodes.rationale: Model structure changes are published because Contentful requires it; appearance alone publishes nothing.

nodes.label: Pre-write destination recheck
nodes.rationale: Right before writing, destination is re-read; if something in the tree appeared, disappeared, was archived or an entry to update was edited during review, it stops without writing.

nodes.label: Production confirmation (type environment name)
nodes.rationale: If destination looks like production (master or aliased) the environment name must be typed to confirm.

nodes.label: Single write module (src/contentful/write.ts)
nodes.rationale: Only one module writes to Contentful, bound to the destination environment, with no way to delete, archive, unpublish or write to origin; enforced by a source-code test.

nodes.label: Tree size limit (300 entries) and 20-entry confirmation
nodes.norm_label: tree size limit (300 entries) and 20-entry confirmation
nodes.rationale: Stops if the tree exceeds 300 entries because a link is probably dragging a whole page; asks confirmation above 20 writes. Limits live in src/config.ts.
